title: Equation of Continuity
sourceLocation: Owner's ChatGPT Library (original master remains outside public GitHub)
sourceScope: Mass conservation, continuity ρAv, incompressible Av, textbook Figures 6.7/6.8, rubber-hose, river and circulatory examples, NBF Example 6.3 and Assignment 6.3; calculations include author-created extension questions.
importantDistinction: Continuity requires density factors and source/sink accounting when appropriate; hose constriction can change discharge, so constant Q is an approximation. Q14 names Fig6.7 but its one-inlet/one-outlet wording is understandable without the image.
limitations: 80 source questions, 4 original options, original answer letters and concise explanations preserved; only PDF-extracted displaced superscripts in Q45/Q53/Q68 restored.
20 real-life questions are independent, not fabricated four-question stimulus groups.
Original teacher key's per-question SLO references retained for provenance, not official independently verified individual SLO/cognitive labels.
Public provisional self-practice only, no saved cloud score.
Standalone only; central Test Builder remains V81 with 1,924 selectable MCQs; full Unit6 still planned.
